source.author: punkduck

pose_text_ja: 足を腰幅より広く開き、画面左の本人の右脚に主に体重をかけ、反対の脚を画面右へ斜めに伸ばす。腰を少し画面左へずらす。画面右の本人の左腕を上げ、肘を外上方へ曲げ、開いた左手のひらを頭の左上側に当て、指を頭頂へ伸ばす。手のひらは頭の側面と上部に見え、首の後ろへ置かない。右腕は右ももの横へ力を抜いて下ろす。首の付け根を中央に保ち、頭頂を少し画面左へ傾ける。鼻先を画面の左端へ約15度はっきり向け、顎を少し引いて左下を見る。顔は画面右の上げた肘から離れる方向へ向ける。頭の左向きを保ったまま、手は頭の側面から頭頂に添える。
pose_template: Feet wider than hip width, weight mainly on the anatomical right leg at screen-left, the other leg extended diagonally toward screen-right. Hips shift slightly to screen-left. Raise the anatomical left arm on screen-right, bend its elbow outward and upward, and lay the open left palm against the upper left side of the head with fingers reaching over the crown. The palm is visible on the side and top of the scalp, not behind the neck. Right arm hangs loose beside the right thigh. The base of the neck stays centered, but the crown shifts slightly toward screen-left. Turn the nose distinctly 15 degrees toward the LEFT edge of the image, chin a little down, eyes looking down-left. The face points away from the raised elbow on screen-right. Keep the raised hand on the side/crown of the head while preserving this left-facing head direction.
original_gemini_prompt: standing with wide stance and hip tilted, one hand placed behind the head with elbow raised high, the other arm relaxed down

prompt_validation.note: 顔方向の説明は再試行文を候補とする。

pose_text_ja: 足を広く開いて立ち、膝をほぼ伸ばす。肘を腰の横の低い位置で曲げ、開いた両手を肩の前の胸上部まで上げる。手のひらを斜め前へ向け、指を自然に広げる。両手の間隔はほぼ肩幅。肩の力を抜き、上体を起こす。頭をほぼ起こしてごく少し画面左へ傾け、顔と目は前へ向ける。会話の身振りで、驚いた表情や頭より高く上げた手にはしない。
pose_template: Stand with feet wide apart and knees nearly straight. Keep elbows low beside the waist and bent, lift both open hands only to upper-chest height in front of the shoulders, palms angled forward, fingers naturally spread. Hands remain about shoulder-width apart. Shoulders relaxed, torso upright. Head nearly upright with a very slight tilt toward screen-left, face toward the viewer, eyes forward. The gesture is conversational, with no startled expression and no hands above the head.
original_gemini_prompt: standing in a wide stance, both hands raised in front of the chest with open palms facing outward in a stop or surrender gesture

prompt_validation.note: 手の高さ・手首の向きを厳密に揃える場合は補正が必要。
